title: CrossNox · historical asymmetric-geometry refinement
description: Historical parameter refinement of OpenAI’s seven-eighths proof to 4374785349/5000000000 = 0.8749570698 for all Dirichlet L-functions, excluding the principal pole. The original development also covers zeta and finite-order Eisenstein Hecke L-functions. A larger slot mass and asymmetric physical lengths are carried through low and high estimates, source moments, Euler corrections and continuation. Source imported from CrossNox/quasi-riemann-hypothesis-extension at 3dddb77a62182f8d530c368ed5e9220079fbd1b9; the upstream README states that the paper, Lean proofs and scripts were entirely AI-generated. This tracker adaptation relocates module imports, renames one local pool helper to avoid a duplicate baseline declaration, and adds the canonical entrypoint, preserving the proof logic and attribution to OpenAI/math. The published numerical refinement is historical; this PR does not claim a new frontier or a completed tracker verification. Historical source date: 2026-10-08, from the original public repository creation timestamp 2026-10-08T15:32:16Z; this dates the source repository, not a later tracker PR or a claimed mathematical discovery.
